title: Multibagger stocks: Ather Energy, Hind Copper, MCX among stocks which surged up to 250% in one year - Multibagger Stocks | The Economic Times
text:
The Indian stock market overall has recorded losses over the past one year, as rising oil prices, escalating Middle East war and AI worries spooked investors. However, few stocks managed to hide from the bears and deliver whopping 100-250% returns over the past year, even as the benchmark Nifty 50 index fell 3%. Check the list of all stocks on Nifty 500 that have delivered over 100% returns over the past one year.

The shares of EV scooter-maker Ather Energy have delivered the highest returns among all the stocks on the Nifty 500 index over the past one year, rallying a whopping 248%. The stock has gained over 19% in one month and is up 96% in 2026 so far. The company has a market capitalisation of Rs 56,957 crore.

HFCL shares have delivered stellar returns of 224% over the past one year, with the stock being up around 250% in 2026 alone. The shares of the company have rallied 235% in three years and 269% in five years. The company currently has a market capitalisation of around Rs 36,609 crore.

Welspun Corp shares rallied 171% over the past one year. The stock is up around 200% in 2026 alone. In the longer term, Welspun Corp shares have delivered stellar returns of 640% in three years and 1,852% in five years.

Aditya Infotech shares surged 151% over the past one year, backed by expanding demand in surveillance technology, smart security solutions, and digital infrastructure across enterprise and government verticals.

Hindustan Copper shares rallied 141% over the past year. The state-owned copper producer benefited from rising global copper prices and robust demand. The stock is in focus over two days as the government is selling a portion of its stake through an offer for sale.

RR Kabel shares gained 136% over the past one year. The wires and cables manufacturer saw its share price gain 91% in 2026 so far. The company currently has a market capitalisation of Rs 31,670 crore.

Netweb Technologies India shares jumped 135% over the past year. The high-performance computing (HPC) witnessed accelerated demand from data center expansions, AI deployments, and cloud infrastructure growth.

Acutaas Chemicals shares surged 123% over the past one year. The stock has gained over 89% in 2026 so far, and 149% in three years. The company has a market capitalisation of Rs 27,089 crore.

Other stocks which recorded multibagger returns over the past one year include Kirloskar Oil Engines (118%), Chennai Petroleum Corporation (114%), National Aluminium Company or NALCO (113%), MCX or Multi Commodity Exchange of India (105%), Laurus Labs (105%), Apar Industries (104%) and Prime Focus (103%).(Disclaimer: Recommendations, suggestions, views and opinions given by the experts are their own. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)
